## What's new
- **Logs tab** – read logs without opening a terminal:
  - **ArrHub** itself (last 1000 messages kept in memory) and the logs of **Radarr, Sonarr, qBittorrent, NZBGet and Seerr**, read through their APIs – nothing extra to set up
  - filter by level (all / info and above / warnings and errors / errors only), search, expand entries for stack traces and details
  - auto-refresh every 10 s while the tab is open, and **Download** saves the current view as a `.log` file
- **ArrHub now logs more** – when a service goes down and when it comes back (once per change, not on every refresh), failed actions, saved settings, bad requests and unexpected errors. ArrHub's own log is always in English.

## Improvements
- **Lighter HTTPS to services** – with an own CA certificate or *Accept self-signed certificate*, the trusted certificate set is prepared once instead of on every connection, and connections are reused: about 5× less CPU and steady memory under load. Each TLS setup has its own connection pool and session cache, so verification is never skipped by reusing a session.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.10.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.9.1...v1.10.0
